title: New user: nothing saved, no presets
purpose: First use of every preset-dependent family with an account that has castles, troops and free commanders but no presets and nothing saved.
simulated: banner: Simulated preview: sample data only. Nothing here reaches the game or an account.
expect: Auto Nomad opens with a recommended one-wave setup built from the source castle's most numerous attack troops; Save stores it as an app-created preset ('Created by app' in Attack Presets).
Reopening the editor keeps hidden Advanced values; 'Save as preset' makes a normal user preset.
Invasion, Berimond attack, Khan and Storm each offer the same inline recommendation; nothing is saved or started by opening an editor.
Disclosure defaults: Advanced groups collapsed with summaries.
